book.name: 2Tesalonika
book.title: 2Tesalonika Tesalonika Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa Aheuḡa

content: Nego nabudi, emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Kerisoꞌa bare ariteꞌe moneo zu emeḡe niduꞌa Iesu zamao nuꞌoratiteꞌe moneo emeꞌa ḡoreziꞌuma.

Vaze nuꞌa ꞌahige raꞌohe, “Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ariteꞌe madaḡa ꞌai amahi feuriro.” Ze zeḡeꞌa bare Badiꞌaꞌa ohozadu ꞌouge ziꞌohe rae raꞌohe, ga zeḡe haramo hina ꞌouge ziꞌohe. Zeꞌe emeḡe mazaonoꞌo meiroteꞌe soꞌaḡa idunaḡano ꞌouge ziꞌohe rae raꞌenaꞌa, zae soꞌozeꞌohe. Zaꞌe zeḡe ḡoere egadu zamaze ago ḡarihe hagaroꞌi zu ꞌadaꞌadazoꞌi.

Iniuꞌa ibi nunuo zae soꞌosoꞌozeꞌeteꞌe gararoꞌi. Mazaḡa Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa ꞌizema arogano, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa agirohaꞌuma ebu ḡonagano Badiꞌaꞌa ruiniteꞌe vazeḡa mazao sauꞌa huneḡaniꞌa fureraꞌuma. Aniꞌe Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa.

Aniꞌe badiꞌa rae huneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa zu vazeꞌa kuranohauꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa agiroziꞌuma ebu eꞌe niduꞌa rana ane ni mae ḡihiniꞌuma. Ebu aniꞌe Badiꞌa kuru neḡano ehoradu aneꞌa bare, “Eꞌe Badiꞌa,” rae fureniꞌuma.
Eꞌeguḡa moneo e zae teite radiunuteꞌe madaḡano ziro. Za mene zamareꞌehe?
Ebu za edeḡa, izidi ḡau ꞌahoganiꞌa vaze sauꞌa huneḡa eꞌe ꞌueꞌohe, rehano ane madaꞌa arine aniꞌa fureraꞌuma.

Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡaniꞌa sifu inare gaueꞌohe, rehano hunioꞌe mene fureraꞌuma. Mazaḡa vaze sauꞌa huneḡaniꞌa gauiteꞌe ibiḡaꞌe vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ꞌuiꞌuma, onamo vaze sauꞌa huneḡa eꞌe ꞌueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa vaḡiniꞌuma.
Ebu hena Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa eꞌeꞌa fureraꞌuma. Eꞌe madaḡano Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesuꞌa hebeꞌanonoꞌo irineḡa hina maꞌuma, ebu Iesuꞌa arine agaḡa boro hina ruiniꞌuma.
Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa varadeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa eꞌeꞌa Satani inaraḡa madu ariꞌuma ebu Satani gauḡa haḡaiꞌuma. Aniꞌa aradu haḡai gigiꞌa nunu, haḡai nu badeḡa, zu zaguzagatiteꞌe haḡaiḡa niduꞌa ḡurire haḡaiꞌuma.
Ebu aniꞌa sauꞌa haḡaiḡa nunu hina Badiꞌaꞌa ruiziteꞌe azaḡa soꞌoziꞌuma. Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa ruiziteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa zeḡe ḡaboziteꞌe ḡoeꞌa huga zamare borofoga hezahoharo.
Eꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe mazao soꞌosoꞌozeꞌeteꞌe inaraḡa tuḡunadu zeꞌa ḡuriro ḡoeꞌa mae ḡihiniꞌuma.
Zeꞌe ḡoere huga mene mae ḡihiniro, rehano haḡai veꞌoḡa haḡaeꞌenaꞌa matuꞌiro. Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe niduꞌa kotaziꞌuma.

Nego nabudi, zaꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro zamarone azaḡa. Emeꞌe iḡaiḡa zae uꞌano Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi rae huniꞌuma, mazaḡa zaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa hina zaḡozaḡifine zu ḡoere huga mae ḡihinadu ḡabone hidifine Badiꞌaꞌa ḡadaheḡano zae ohotiro.
Eꞌe veize, emeꞌa haramiroteꞌe hariḡa manoḡa hina Badiꞌaꞌa zae huziro. ꞌOugadu zae zuni emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso ni ḡihiꞌaḡa meiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo, nego nabudi, edau gigaranadu emeḡeꞌa hebe hina ziroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ga soꞌa hina ihoziroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa obone giganoꞌi.

Eme zae veize emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Iesu Keriso zu Badiꞌa emeḡe Mama mazao kurauꞌohe. Badiꞌaꞌe emeḡe zamare borofeꞌohe. Aniꞌa emeḡe mazao manoḡa furenadu inarafiro onamo radiu tuḡutuḡu, ebu ḡabone tuḡutuḡu mae ḡihineꞌenaꞌa guhineꞌeteꞌe zamaroneḡa manoḡa rifiro.
Badiꞌa zu Iesuꞌa zamaze inaranoꞌi zu haḡaize manoḡa niduꞌa zu ḡoereze manoḡa niduꞌa zamaḡano inara ziniꞌenoꞌi.
